name: Hozumi
source:
Affiliation: The Three Worms
Bug: Tick
Ability: Sharing - Cloud. A bug focused on information processing with zero fighting capability. [spoiler]Capable of simultaneously sharing different senses, memories and experiences, including one's own between multiple people.[/spoiler]

Leading member of the Three Worms (三尸), neutral supervisors of the death game taking place who keep record of all battles and notable events. Poses a rather serious attitude and holds rules above all else.
